title: Clean up a messy email
drDigitalIntro:
Time to put it all together. This one uses every keyboard skill from Unit 2.
• Someone wrote this email in a hurry. Words got typed twice, sentences start with a small letter, and the days of the week are not capitalized.
• Open your Drafts folder, then open the draft to start editing.
• Use the arrow keys to reach each mistake and Delete to take out the extra words.
• When it reads properly, click Send. Sending it is the point.
• The Mail app gets its own unit later (Unit 6) — the highlights lead you to the draft, and the keyboard work is the test.

playgroundTask.goal: Fix the messy draft and send it

seedDraft.subject: Team meeting reminder
seedDraft.body:
hey sarah

i wanted to remind you the team meeting meeting is is on thursday at 3pm in the big conference room

can you bring the the budget report

see you thursday

thanks
mike

steps.say: Click Drafts in the sidebar to see your saved drafts.
Click on the Team meeting reminder draft to open it for editing.
Fix the body: delete the duplicate words and fix the capitals, so the line reads "the meeting is on Thursday". Click outside the text box when you are done.
Click Send to send the fixed email.

drDigitalSuccess: You cleaned that draft up with the keyboard alone and sent it. Those same shortcuts work in every program on the machine.
drDigitalHint: Use the arrow keys to move to each mistake and Delete to remove the duplicate word. After editing, click outside the body text box, then click Send.
